```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/Users/murvinmm/Documents/Murvin_2026/")

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(ragg)

# 1) read_sample(): drop the 'bin' column and explicitly return
read_sample <- function(path, prefix, chr_filter) {
  df <- read.delim(path, header = FALSE)
  colnames(df) <- c("bin", "chr", "start", "end",
                    paste0(prefix, ".b6.count"),
                    paste0(prefix, ".cast.count"))
  df <- subset(df, chr == chr_filter)
  df <- df[, !(names(df) %in% "bin")]
  return(df)
}

# 2) read_snps(): filter out chr≠chr_filter AND snp.count < 25, drop 'bin', zero‐fill NAs
read_snps <- function(path, chr_filter) {
  read.delim(path, header = FALSE) %>%
    setNames(c("chr", "start", "end", "bin", "snp.count")) %>%
    filter(chr == chr_filter, snp.count >= 25) %>%
    select(-bin) %>%
    replace(is.na(.), 0)
}

# 3) moving_average(): 9‐bin, center‐aligned rolling mean with NA at the edges
moving_average <- function(x, n = 9) {
  rollmean(x, n, fill = NA, align = "center")
}

# 4) process_and_plot(): main function
process_and_plot <- function(
  s1, s2, s3, s4,
  snp_file, chr_filter,
  reads1, reads2, reads3, reads4,
  output_prefix,
  x_limits, y_limits, plot_title, rect_coords,
  lab1, lab2, lab3, lab4,
  norm_label,
  tile_colors = c("#172869", "#EA7580", "grey20","grey55")
) {
  # — Read & merge —
  samp1 <- read_sample(s1, "sample1", chr_filter)
  samp2 <- read_sample(s2, "sample2", chr_filter)
  samp3 <- read_sample(s3, "sample3", chr_filter)
  samp4 <- read_sample(s4, "sample4", chr_filter)
  snps  <- read_snps(snp_file, chr_filter)

  df <- merge(samp1, samp2, by = c("chr", "start", "end"))
  df <- merge(df, samp3,   by = c("chr", "start", "end"))
  df <- merge(df, samp4,   by = c("chr", "start", "end"))
  df <- merge(df, snps,    by = c("chr", "start", "end"))
  df[is.na(df)] <- 0

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      sample1.b6.rpm.norm   = sample1.b6.count   / reads1   / snp.count,
      sample1.cast.rpm.norm = sample1.cast.count / reads1   / snp.count,
      sample2.b6.rpm.norm   = sample2.b6.count   / reads2   / snp.count,
      sample2.cast.rpm.norm = sample2.cast.count / reads2   / snp.count,
      sample3.b6.rpm.norm   = sample3.b6.count   / reads3   / snp.count,
      sample3.cast.rpm.norm = sample3.cast.count / reads3   / snp.count,
      sample4.b6.rpm.norm   = sample4.b6.count   / reads4   / snp.count,
      sample4.cast.rpm.norm = sample4.cast.count / reads4   / snp.count
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(
      ends_with("rpm.norm"),
      ~ moving_average(., 9),
      .names = "{.col}.smoothed"
    )) %>%
    mutate(across(
      ends_with(".smoothed"),
      ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.), 0, .)
    )) %>%
    mutate(
      sample1.B6_minus_CAST.smoothed = sample1.b6.rpm.norm.smoothed   - sample1.cast.rpm.norm.smoothed,
      sample2.B6_minus_CAST.smoothed = sample2.b6.rpm.norm.smoothed   - sample2.cast.rpm.norm.smoothed,
      sample3.B6_minus_CAST.smoothed = sample3.b6.rpm.norm.smoothed   - sample3.cast.rpm.norm.smoothed,
      sample4.B6_minus_CAST.smoothed = sample4.b6.rpm.norm.smoothed   - sample4.cast.rpm.norm.smoothed
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Avg_B6_Dox.smoothed     = (sample1.b6.rpm.norm.smoothed   + sample3.b6.rpm.norm.smoothed)   / 2,
      Avg_B6_NoDox.smoothed   = (sample2.b6.rpm.norm.smoothed   + sample4.b6.rpm.norm.smoothed)   / 2,
      Avg_CAST_Dox.smoothed   = (sample1.cast.rpm.norm.smoothed + sample3.cast.rpm.norm.smoothed) / 2,
      Avg_CAST_NoDox.smoothed = (sample2.cast.rpm.norm.smoothed + sample4.cast.rpm.norm.smoothed) / 2
    )

  write.table(
    df,
    paste0(output_prefix, "_processed.txt"),
    sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
  )

  # — Tiling plot —
  p_tiles <- ggplot(df, aes(x = start / 1e6)) +
    annotate("rect",
      xmin = rect_coords[1], xmax = rect_coords[2],
      ymin = -Inf,            ymax = Inf,
      fill = "cyan", alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Avg_B6_NoDox.smoothed, color = lab2),
               size = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Avg_B6_Dox.smoothed,   color = lab1),
               size = 0.1, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Avg_CAST_NoDox.smoothed, color = lab4),
               size = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Avg_CAST_Dox.smoothed,   color = lab3),
               size = 0.1, alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(tile_colors, c(lab2, lab1, lab4, lab3))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste(chr_filter, "position (Mb)"),
      y = paste(plot_title, "\n", norm_label),
      color = NULL
    ) +    
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(x_limits[1], x_limits[2], (x_limits[2] - x_limits[1]) / 4), labels = function(x) {
    ifelse(x %% 1 == 0, as.character(x), sprintf("%.1f", x))
  }) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, y_limits[2], y_limits[2]),
      labels = function(x) {
    ifelse(x %% 1 == 0, as.character(x), sprintf("%.1f", x))
  }
    )+
    coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits, ylim = c(0, y_limits[2])) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.line  = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      text           = element_text(family = "Arial")
    )


# small file for paper
ragg::agg_png(paste0(output_prefix, "_small_tiling.png"),
              width = 3, height = 1.7, units = "in", res = 300, scaling = 1)
print(p_tiles)
dev.off()

# large file for ppts
ragg::agg_png(paste0(output_prefix, "_large_tiling.png"),
              width = 30, height = 17, units = "in", res = 300, scaling = 9)
print(p_tiles)
dev.off()

  return(df)
}

# 5) generate_interval_boxplot(): updated to filter B6 > max CAST
generate_interval_boxplot <- function(
  data, interval_start, interval_end, chr,
  output_prefix, sample_labels, sample_colors,
  plot_title, norm_label, comparisons
) {
  # subset to interval
  df_int_raw <- data %>%
    filter(start >= interval_start,
           start <= interval_end)

  
  # pivot on B6−CAST differences
  df_int <- df_int_raw %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = ends_with("B6_minus_CAST.smoothed"),
      names_to  = "sample",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(sample = factor(
      sample,
      levels = names(sample_labels),
      labels = sample_labels
    ))

  # recompute whiskers & y-limits to match data scales
  whiskers     <- df_int %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(uw = boxplot.stats(value)$stats[5])
  sig_position <- max(whiskers$uw, na.rm = TRUE)
  # your if/else ladder to set y_limit based on sig_position
  if      ((sig_position*1.05) <= 0.04) y_limit <- 0.04
  else if ((sig_position*1.05) <= 0.05) y_limit <- 0.05
  else if ((sig_position*1.05) <= 0.06) y_limit <- 0.06
  else if ((sig_position*1.05) <= 0.1)  y_limit <- 0.1
  else if ((sig_position*1.05) <= 0.15) y_limit <- 0.15
  else if ((sig_position*1.05) <= 0.2)  y_limit <- 0.2
  else if ((sig_position*1.05) <= 0.25) y_limit <- 0.25
  else if ((sig_position*1.05) <= 0.3)  y_limit <- 0.3
  else if ((sig_position*1.05) <= 0.35) y_limit <- 0.35
  else                                 y_limit <- 0.4
  y_breaks <- seq(0, y_limit, length.out = 2)

  # build boxplot
  p_box <- ggplot(df_int, aes(x = sample, y = value, fill = sample)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.49, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sample_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, y_limit),
      breaks = y_breaks,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
      labels = function(x) ifelse(x==0, "0", format(x, trim = TRUE, nsmall = 1))
    ) +
    labs(
      x     = NULL,
      y     = norm_label,
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method      = "t.test",
      method.args = list(alternative = "greater"),
      label       = "p.signif",
      label.y     = sig_position * 0.95,
      tip.length  = 0,
      bracket.size= 0
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size=12, color="black"),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(angle=90, size=12, color="black",
                                     margin=margin(r=-5,b=10), hjust=0),
      axis.line       = element_line(color="black"),
      axis.ticks      = element_line(color="black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      text            = element_text(family="Arial")
    )

  # small for papers
ragg::agg_png(paste0(output_prefix,"_small_interval_boxplot_05_17_25.png"),
              width = 1.4, height = 1.3, units = "in", res = 300)
print(p_box)
dev.off()

# large for ppts
ragg::agg_png(paste0(output_prefix,"_large_interval_boxplot_05_17_25.png"),
              width = 14, height = 13, units = "in", res = 300, scaling = 9)
print(p_box)
dev.off()
  return(p_box)
}


```

```{r plot_H2AK119ub_HK, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}


file_pairs_K119_HK <- list(
  list(
    "F18_tsc_HK_g3_4_Dox_H2AK119ub_chip_S12_R1_001_mm10-allelic_10kb-bins.txt",
    "F18_tsc_HK_g3_4_nodox_H2AK119ub_chip_S11_R1_001_mm10-allelic_10kb-bins.txt",
    18.028595, 20.361483, "HK g3+4 Dox", "HK g3+4 No Dox",
    "F14_tsc_HK_g1_Dox_H2AK119ub_chip_S5_R1_001_mm10-allelic_10kb-bins.txt",
    "F14_tsc_HK_g1_nodox_H2AK119ub_chip_S6_R1_001_mm10-allelic_10kb-bins.txt",
    13.146822, 12.963742, "HK g1 Dox", "HK g1 No Dox"
  )
)
# have to make XIst bigger than it is note, shoudl be 103.46 to 103.48
chromosomes_K119 <- list(
  list("chrX",  c(0,150),   c(0,0.15), "H2AK119ub", c(103,104), c(0,150)),
  list("chr17", c(3,24),    c(0,0.15), "H2AK119ub", c(12.74,12.86),    c(3,24)),
  list("chr7",  c(142,144.4),c(0,0.1),  "H2AK119ub", c(143.213111,143.296547), c(142,144.4))
)

snp_file_K119 <- "sanger_mm10_cast_all-chr-10kb-bins.bed"

for (chr in chromosomes_K119) {
  for (pair in file_pairs_K119_HK) {
    prefix <- paste0(gsub(".txt","",pair[[1]]), "_", chr[[1]], "_rpm_norm_avg")

    fd <- process_and_plot(
      s1            = pair[[1]],
      s2            = pair[[2]],
      s3            = pair[[7]],
      s4            = pair[[8]],
      snp_file      = snp_file_K119,
      chr_filter    = chr[[1]],
      reads1        = pair[[3]],
      reads2        = pair[[4]],
      reads3        = pair[[9]],
      reads4        = pair[[10]],
      output_prefix = prefix,
      x_limits      = chr[[2]],
      y_limits      = chr[[3]],
      plot_title    = chr[[4]],
      rect_coords   = chr[[5]],
      lab1          = pair[[5]],
      lab2          = pair[[6]],
      lab3          = pair[[11]],
      lab4          = pair[[12]],
      norm_label    = "B6 RPM norm",
      tile_colors   = c("#172869","#EA7580","grey20","grey55")
    )


    labs <- c(pair[[6]], pair[[5]], pair[[12]], pair[[11]])
    names(labs) <- c(
      "sample2.B6_minus_CAST.smoothed",
      "sample1.B6_minus_CAST.smoothed",
      "sample4.B6_minus_CAST.smoothed",
      "sample3.B6_minus_CAST.smoothed"
    )
    cols <- c("#172869","#EA7580","skyblue","pink")
    names(cols) <- labs
    comps <- list(c(pair[[6]], pair[[5]]), c(pair[[12]], pair[[11]]))

    generate_interval_boxplot(
      fd,
      interval_start = chr[[6]][1] * 1e6,
      interval_end   = chr[[6]][2] * 1e6,
      chr[[1]],
     prefix,
      sample_labels  = labs,
      sample_colors  = cols,
      plot_title     = chr[[4]],
      norm_label     = "RPM norm\n(B6 – CAST)",
      comparisons    = comps
    )
  }
}
```

```{r plot_H2AK119ub_HNRNPU, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
      output_prefix  = prefix,
      sample_labels  = labs,
      sample_colors  = cols,
      plot_title     = chr[[4]],
      norm_label     = "RPM norm\n(B6 – CAST)",
      comparisons    = comps
    )
  }
}
```
